limitations: Models the guarded publication, consume and compare-delete contract for one challenge, two publishers and two namespaces. Challenge renewal, transition(), backend selection and arbitrary publication batches need separate models.

Generated Quint traces replay through the real MemoryBackend, NamespacedStoreBackend and TokenStore. The existing embedded-auth-store integration test checks concurrent publication and expiry against PGlite. Redis atomicity and PostgreSQL serializability remain backend assumptions outside this model.
Safety does not assert eventual authentication. External completion, request scheduling, restart persistence and clock changes require separate progress and deployment checks.
